items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: That was Shack, that was Garfield Cotter, the Cotter boys... I was in California? No, no, in Norfolk, Virginia... So that's a musical family.

that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, that, Well, the first number I played on the trumpet when I left Hampton Institute.
